evidence: Workbook check 25: 'Every dimension prompt sends the judge into the live app via the browser tool - not scoring from source, memory, or a first-paint guess.' Skill quality-checks.md:109-110: verify every prompt opens http://localhost:3000 and directs the judge to the Playwright MCP tool; defect is any prompt satisfiable by reading source, memory or a first paint. All five task prompts satisfy this on their text. (1) URL + tool: gates/render/prompt.md:1, gates/constraints/prompt.md:1, scored/polish/prompt.md:1, scored/visual/prompt.md:1 each begin 'Open http://localhost:3000 using Playwright.'; scored/functional/prompt.md:3 says the same. Every judge.toml I read wires a 'playwright' stdio MCP server (render/constraints lines 8-12, polish/visual lines 8-12, functional lines 7-11), and functional additionally wires the 'verifier' restart server. (2) Source forbidden: the same first line in the four shorter prompts says 'Use rendered UI and ordinary browser-observed product data only. Never inspect app source, bundles, filesystem, database files or implementation code. No shell or private-file probes.'; functional/prompt.md:3 says 'Never inspect application source, bundles, filesystem, database files or implementation scripts; only rendered product UI, user-entered data and the app's ordinary browser-observed requests/responses are evidence. No shell.' (3) Not memory: unobserved outcomes must be reported as 'NOT EXERCISED - evaluator/tool limitation' rather than inferred (render:11, polish:18, visual:16, functional:15), and functional:15 adds 'A failed sibling verdict is not evidence against another row'. (4) Not first paint: the render gate criterion (gates/render/judge.toml:23) requires a wrong-password attempt, then a correct sign-in, then a workspace with usable navigation, and states 'A static login/workspace picture or only a health response is insufficient'; the constraints gate requires UI creation of a requisition and offer and retrieval in a new browser context (constraints/prompt.md:9-11); each scored prompt carries a create-then-fresh-context-readback gate (functional:13, polish:11, visual:11) where 'a same-context tab/reload or HTTP200 is insufficient'; visual/prompt.md:14 then requires a review of coordinated changes, requisitions, offers, equity, referrals, audit and detail/form surfaces, so the visual Likert rows are not scored from the sign-in screen; polish/prompt.md:16 and the five polish criteria are stateful interaction sequences. The task wording 'using Playwright' drops the template's 'MCP' but the tool is still named and wired. What the task does well: it is stricter than the template, which has no explicit ban on source inspection. LIMITS OF THIS REVIEW: this is a static prompt/wiring reading only. raw-evidence-index.json states that full configured grading is absent, and its ten hash-verified artifacts are scripted golden runs, not judge runs, so no log shows a configured judge actually driving the browser under these prompts. Separately, four prompts name the tool 'browser_run_code_unsafe' for the fresh-context step (constraints:11, polish:11, visual:11, functional:13 and 19); I did not verify that @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 (tests/Dockerfile:19) exposes a tool of that name with the judge's launch arguments. If it does not, the scored-dimension gates could not be established and those dimensions would return NOT EXERCISED zeros; that is an unmeasured tool-feasibility risk, not a demonstrated defect of this row. I did not read the full functional criteria body, so I cannot attest that no individual functional criterion is decidable without the browser; that belongs mainly to row 32.
counterexample: Broken app that could pass: a static HTML picture of a signed-in workspace. It fails here, because render requires a refused wrong password followed by a real sign-in, and every other dimension requires a UI-created record read back in a separate browser context. Conforming alternative that could fail: an app whose record lists live behind a different navigation layout or labels; the prompts say 'Discover routes and controls by intent, not assumed names', so the prompts do not fail it on this row. No counterexample found that the prompt text admits.
suggested_fix: No prompt change needed for this row. Before clearance, obtain one configured judge launch log showing Playwright MCP tool calls in each of the five dimensions, and confirm from the tool list of @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 that the tool named in the prompts for the fresh-context step exists under that exact name.
